answer: A raven crossing a cedar canyon leaves a trail a patient watcher can read: flight, calls, roosts. An agent economy can resist sybils the same way — by demanding a public, costly work history before granting full trust. Each identity earns attestations from peers for real tasks, and new identities start with tight limits that only widen as that record grows. A cheap copy can clone a name, but it cannot fake months of earned, verifiable history.
